key_observations: The distribution-shift effect remains visible after the corrected run, but subgroup variation makes a broad robustness claim premature.

The lab discussion introduced a plausible alternative interpretation, so the next experiment should distinguish between a genuine robustness limitation and an artifact of the particular shift construction.
The researcher converted the uncertainty into a bounded experiment with an explicit seed, shift condition, metrics, and stopping criteria rather than expanding the search space.
The manuscript now reflects the more cautious interpretation, and the replication study remains intentionally parked.
priority_alignment: The main research question dominated the day through analysis, collaboration, manuscript revision, and experiment design.
The manuscript and experiment plan were updated in response to actual evidence rather than being developed independently.
The replication study did not consume meaningful research time beyond its existing documentation.
important_uncertainty: The subgroup variation could reflect differences in the shift itself rather than a fundamental limitation of the method.
One additional controlled comparison is needed before deciding whether the distribution-shift limitation belongs in the central research claim.
expected_reflection.possible_next_step: Run the explicitly specified follow-up comparison once, using the preselected seed and shift condition, then decide whether the evidence supports a broader experiment matrix.
